# Input

`ui.input` · parts: `Input` · elements: `<input>`

## Purpose

Input is a single-line native form control (checkbox/radio have their own primitives).

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
_No additional notes for Input yet._
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Input renders a native input element (default type text).

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Void / self-contained element: children are not accepted.

## ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` (omitted when empty).
- Typed ARIA props: `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` — static values only.

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `inputClasses({ ... })` from `input/input.shared.ts` |
| templ | `input.InputClasses(input.InputProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('inputClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::inputClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `input_classes(p)` |

## Usage

Fixture `email` (`{"Type":"email","Name":"email","Placeholder":"you@example.com","Required":true}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<input type="email" name="email" placeholder="you@example.com" required>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Input } from "./ui/input/input";

<Input type="email" required name="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Input from "./ui/input/Input.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Input type="email" required name="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Input from "./ui/input/Input.svelte";
</script>

<Input type="email" required={true} name="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Input } from "./ui/input/input.solid";

<Input type="email" required name="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderInput } from "./ui/input/input.wc";

document.body.append(renderInput({ type: "email", required: true, name: "email", placeholder: "you@example.com" }));
```

**Go templ** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/templ.md))

```templ
import "github.com/ui8kit/codegen/generated/templ/ui/input"

@input.Input(input.InputProps{Type: "email", Name: "email", Placeholder: "you@example.com", Required: true})
```

**Twig** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/twig.md))

```twig
{% include 'input/Input.html.twig' with { type: 'email', name: 'email', placeholder: 'you@example.com', required: true } only %}
```

**Latte** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/latte.md))

```latte
{include 'input/Input.latte', type: 'email', name: 'email', placeholder: 'you@example.com', required: true}
```

**Jinja2** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/jinja2.md))

```jinja
{% with p = {'Type': 'email', 'Name': 'email', 'Placeholder': 'you@example.com', 'Required': True} %}{% include 'ui/input/input.html.j2' %}{% endwith %}
```
